original_card.question: Can one reproducible environment or artifact-comparison failure be repaired?
methods: Reproduce one portability failure and add a minimal cross-environment fix.
Audit one canonical-payload comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Preserve immutable source hashes and proof-relevant content; a different compressed byte stream alone is not a mathematical mismatch.

original_card.first_experiment: Reproduce one specific mismatch or audit one canonical comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Portable exact checks prevent environment failures from blocking valid contributions.
allowed_variations: One interpreter/version mismatch or one payload field comparison.
scope_change_triggers: Removing immutable-source pins because generated compressed bytes differ.

actual_scope: Repair the retained PR2753 Windows path-inventory mismatch in the exact PR4790 six-case integration replay, using one source-bound in-memory expression adapter and preserving the complete typed receipt.
scope_change_reason: Handoff-first selection: PR4949 explicitly left full integration unexecuted on Windows. The portable-replay card is narrowed to that concrete caller and authentication boundary; no new cost or mathematical identity is proposed.
bottleneck_link: A platform-specific source-inventory failure prevents independently replaying actual producer/service calls, guards and controlled cleanup. Restore that finite execution without weakening authentication or claiming supplier admission.
stop_rule: Stop at the exact inventory failure unless a single authenticated path-rendering correction preserves every original check and full receipt. No production geometry, full mathematical cold replay, expanded protocol search or selected-frontier change.
evidence: verify.py authenticates 143 retained live files, adapts exactly one PR2753 path expression, exercises actual authentication and complete-receipt fault controls, and runs all six original PR4790 cases through its unchanged aggregator. README records commands, platform results and limits.
author: Mihir Srivastava
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for investigation, implementation, verification and writing. No subagents, independent human review or formal-kernel acceptance.
